name: s2k_staticLoadCase
formula: =LAMBDA(name,TEXTJOIN("   ", FALSE, "Case=" & name, "LoadType=" & CHAR(34) & "Load pattern" & CHAR(34), "LoadName=" & name, "LoadSF=1"))
comment: Create text regarding static load case assignment definition data in SAP2000 $2k format. Assume there is a load case name the same as the load pattern name. Last Update at 2024-07-11.
